# Test fixtures

## `sample.webm`

~4s, WebM container, Opus audio (`audio/webm;codecs=opus` — the exact MIME type
`whisper-vibes`' `use-loop-recorder.ts` MediaRecorder fallback selects), real English speech.

**Provenance**: generated by a real Chromium `MediaRecorder` session (via Playwright), fed the
same speech content as `stt-server/crates/runtime/tests/fixtures/sample.wav` through Chromium's
`--use-fake-device-for-media-stream` / `--use-file-for-fake-audio-capture` fake-microphone flags.
This means the file exercises the app's actual browser-side recording code path end to end
(including Chromium's real Opus encoder), not a synthetically constructed WebM/Opus file — the
same property `sample.wav` has for the WAV path.

Used to test `decode.rs`'s WebM/Opus decode path (symphonia demuxes the container and identifies
the Opus track; libopus, via the `audiopus`/`audiopus_sys` crates, decodes the raw packets) and the
full `/v1/audio/transcriptions` request/response cycle for the app's non-WAV recording format.
